baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reversed pair يُولِجُ ... فِي ... وَيُولِجُ ... فِي repeats one causative construction while exchanging night and day.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each opposed temporal medium is made to enter the other. The double reversal depicts a permeable boundary and reciprocal transfer, not one side simply erasing the other.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry into another interior supplies the two-way transfer mechanism.
Night as darkness supplies one persistent medium in the reciprocal pair.
Day as opening by light supplies the counter-medium into which darkness enters and which enters darkness.

changed_reading.after: God repeatedly inserts each temporal medium into the other, making their boundary a reversible zone of transfer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَسَخَّرَ ... كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ gives the sun and moon individually directed motion toward a limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Subjection converts celestial motion from autonomous recurrence into service under direction; distributive totality gives each body a course, and the course is vectorized toward a fixed temporal boundary.

activation_trace.role: Subduing and steering something for a purpose makes the celestial motion governed service.
The sun supplies the first concrete bearer of the governed course.
The moon and its light supply the second distinct bearer rather than a fused pair.
Encompassing totality distributes the predicate to every named luminary.
Continuous running supplies the sustained motion of each course.
A prescribed temporal limit supplies the destination toward which each course runs.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon move until a time.
changed_reading.after: Each luminary performs a separately governed course whose continuous service is oriented toward a prescribed terminus.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse opens with أَلَمْ تَرَ and closes with خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rhetorical act of seeing moves from sensory evidence into reflective judgment, while the final clause reverses the gaze: human work is already known in its interior reality.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight makes the cosmic process evidence addressed to the reader.
Reflection and considered judgment extend seeing beyond bare eyesight.
Intentional action supplies the human object of the closing scrutiny.
Knowledge of an affair's interior turns observation into reciprocal accountability.

changed_reading.before: A cosmic sign is followed by a general reminder that God knows deeds.
changed_reading.after: The reader is taught to penetrate the visible sign while being reminded that intentional deeds are themselves penetrated by expert knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى modifies the endpoint with a passive designation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The endpoint is not merely eventual; it has been named and thereby individuated in advance. Direction, duration, and designation form one schedule.

activation_trace.role: The fixed duration supplies the bounded endpoint.
Naming as designation makes the endpoint specified rather than merely possible.

changed_reading.after: Every course proceeds toward an already designated boundary with its own identity in the governing order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins entering, نَهَار, running, and أَجَل in one temporal mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: A secondary material image treats night and day as volumes admitted into one another, day as an opened river-channel, celestial motion as flow, and the endpoint as a collecting basin. This models measured time as regulated hydraulic exchange.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the inlet action.
A river cutting a channel with running water supplies the flow-medium image within the day root.
Flowing and running connect the temporal exchange to moving liquid.
A basin that gathers and later releases water supplies an exploratory image for the terminal collector.

changed_reading.before: Night and day alternate on a clock.
changed_reading.after: Measured time can also be pictured as two regulated flows entering one another and running toward a collecting limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The descent and delivery of water into earth, followed by growth in paired kinds, revises the hydraulic baseline into an ecological circulation: celestial timing admits the conditions from which differentiated terrestrial life emerges.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal entry remains the focus-side transfer operation.
The river-channel branch keeps the changed reading materially anchored in the focus day root.
Delivering something downward supplies the first movement in the ecological circuit.
Conveying water by pouring supplies the transferred material.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the transformed output of the transfer.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies differentiated but coordinated products.

structural_cues: 31:10 orders descent, water, emergence, and paired kinds, while repeating كُلّ before 31:29's reciprocal ingress and كُلٌّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a downward water-to-growth sequence and the focus supplies reciprocal temporal entry; I infer that the timing exchange enables the growth circuit. A live alternative is that the two passages are parallel signs without a causal ecological arrow.

changed_reading.before: The day/night exchange is a self-contained astronomical cycle.
changed_reading.after: The exchange also regulates a circulation by which above becomes water below and water becomes paired growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden carrying, weakness layered upon weakness, separation after a measured two-year span, and eventual return activate an embodied model of time: phases enter one another through maturation before a marked separation.

activation_trace.role: Entry into another interior anchors the overlapping-phase model in the focus.
A prescribed duration anchors maturation to a bounded span.
An inward pregnancy or fruit-bearing supplies the hidden phase that contains what follows.
Repeated weakening supplies cumulative transition rather than an instantaneous switch.
A child separated from mother or nursing supplies the eventual boundary between phases.
The year-cycle supplies the explicit measure of maturation.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the trajectory through the phases.

structural_cues: 31:14 moves from interior carrying through repeated weakness and timed weaning to return; 31:29 likewise moves through mutual ingress to a designated term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an embodied timed transition and the focus supplies mutual temporal entry; I use gestation and weaning as a process analogy for gradual phase conversion. The live alternative is to keep 31:29 strictly calendrical and 31:14 strictly filial.

changed_reading.before: Night and day replace one another externally.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual ingress can be read as maturation: one phase grows within another until a measured separation, while both remain directed toward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twice the context sequences return, being informed, and prior work. This turns the focus's expert knowledge from a static attribute into a return-and-disclosure process parallel to every celestial course running toward its term.

activation_trace.role: Continuous directed motion supplies the focus-side trajectory.
Intentional work supplies what the human trajectory carries.
Interior knowledge supplies the basis for eventual disclosure.
Returning to a prior source supplies the first explicit human endpoint.
A delivered report turns known work into disclosed information.
The repeated intentional-work branch identifies the report's content.
The second return repeats and stabilizes the endpoint pattern.
The second report confirms disclosure after return.
Repeated work again supplies the disclosed payload.

structural_cues: 31:15 and 31:23 repeat the same return-report-work order before 31:29 joins a toward-term course to expert knowledge of work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two human return-report sequences and one cosmic course-to-term sequence; I infer a shared accountability architecture. A live alternative is that the cosmic and human trajectories are juxtaposed evidence rather than structurally parallel processes.

changed_reading.before: God presently knows what people do.
changed_reading.after: Present expert knowledge anticipates a directed return at which carried work becomes a report, just as every governed course reaches its term.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mustard-grain weight nested in rock, sky, or earth is still brought forth and paired with subtlety and expertise. The focus's inward-entry language and خَبِيرٌ therefore extend to actions hidden at minute scale and inside resistant locations.

activation_trace.role: Interior entry supplies the focus-side capacity to cross enclosing boundaries.
Intentional action remains the object whose concealment cannot defeat knowledge.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies the focus-side epistemic claim.
A measured weight supplies minute accountable scale.
A germinating seed supplies the tiny object that can remain latent yet consequential.
Massive hard rock supplies resistant enclosure.
Fineness, minuteness, and hiddenness supply the mode by which enclosure is traversed.
The repeated expert knowledge explicitly binds tiny hidden location to the focus close.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests a minimal weight through successively large enclosures, then closes with the same خَبِير predicate used in 31:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested concealment, retrieval, subtlety, and repeated expertise; I infer that the focus's cosmic ingress images the reach of knowledge into hidden deeds. A live alternative limits ingress to temporal change and uses the repeated predicate only as thematic echo.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause means that no ordinary action escapes notice.
changed_reading.after: The closing clause also claims scale- and enclosure-crossing knowledge: even a latent act embedded like a seed in rock remains retrievable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated seeing-and-subjection frame is expanded by complete blessings described as outward and inward. Visible celestial regularity becomes the exposed face of a service whose interior operation is not exhausted by sight, matching the move from تَرَ to خَبِير.

activation_trace.role: Reflective seeing anchors the move from visible evidence to inferred interior order.
Knowledge of the inside completes the focus's surface-to-interior arc.
Repeated seeing supplies the explicit formal bridge to the earlier sign.
Repeated purposeful subjection broadens the focus's two luminaries to all available service.
Completion and fullness make the service encompassing rather than fragmentary.
Beneficent condition identifies the subjected order as provision.
Emergence into visibility supplies the outer face available to observation.
The hidden interior of an affair supplies the unexposed complement known by expertise.

structural_cues: 31:20 and 31:29 share أَلَمْ تَرَ, divine agency, and سَخَّرَ; only 31:20 explicitly names the outward/inward pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated frame plus the outward/inward distinction; I infer that 31:29's visible cycle is an outer disclosure of inward governance. A live alternative reads outward/inward only as types of blessing, without making it a hermeneutic for the later sign.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the sky is sufficient recognition of the sign.
changed_reading.after: Seeing is only the outer threshold; the reciprocal ingress discloses an inwardly governed provision that expert knowledge, not eyesight alone, comprehends.

context_deltas.mechanism: An ocean repeatedly extended yet unable to exhaust the words is followed by plural creation and resurrection compressed like one self. Against that scale, each finite celestial course is a bounded execution within inexhaustible command, not a measure of the command's capacity.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing totality distributes finitude across every celestial course.
A prescribed limit supplies local boundedness.
Vast abundant water supplies the scale of the attempted writing medium.
Connected addition supplying further material creates serial extension.
Non-exhaustion negates an endpoint for the words while sharpening the finite endpoints in focus.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the inexhaustible governing expression.
Rousing what was still supplies reactivation at maximal human scale.
Unifying many things in one direction supplies compression of multiplicity into one act.

structural_cues: 31:27 denies exhaustion, 31:28 collapses multiplicity to one self, and 31:29 immediately distributes a finite term to each course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inexhaustible words, one-act compression, and bounded courses; I infer a distinction between finite executions and inexhaustible governing capacity. A live alternative reads the three verses as separate demonstrations of power without this scale relation.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term mainly stresses that cosmic bodies are finite.
changed_reading.after: Their finite terms become bounded instances of an order whose expressive and re-creative capacity is explicitly not exhausted by those instances.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship runs through the sea, is covered by an interfolding wave like overhead canopies, and reaches dry land by rescue. This activates the sea-depth branch latent in the focus's split root and revises temporal flow into navigation through alternating envelopes toward a shore-like term.

activation_trace.role: The deep and turbulent body of the sea supplies a form-distant medium latent in the focus's split root mapping.
Running and flowing anchor navigation in the focus predicate.
The fixed endpoint supplies the journey's terminal orientation.
A vessel moving circularly in water supplies the vehicle image.
The exact repeated running branch transfers the focus predicate into navigation.
Abundant wide water supplies the vessel's traversed medium.
A covering laid over something supplies engulfment by an alternating envelope.
Interfolding turbulence supplies the unstable boundary through which passage occurs.
An overhead canopy supplies the enclosing shape of the wave.
Escape by separation supplies emergence from the engulfing medium.
Dry land supplies the reached shore and material analogue of a term.

structural_cues: 31:31 repeats تَرَ and تَجْرِي after 31:29; 31:32 then sequences covering wave, rescue, and arrival on land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated running plus a complete sea-passage sequence; I infer that the focus can be spatially rehearsed as navigation through alternating media toward shore. A live alternative treats the shared جري only as separate examples of subjection.

changed_reading.before: The luminaries run abstractly along celestial tracks.
changed_reading.after: Their courses can also be imagined as navigation: they traverse mutually covering temporal seas and remain oriented toward a shore-like appointed term.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded day is one on which parent and child cannot stand in for one another; a true promise is opposed to deceptive worldly life. This activates كُلٌّ as more than celestial distribution: each course toward term rehearses an individually nontransferable horizon.

activation_trace.role: Totality distributed over each member anchors individualized courses in the focus.
A prescribed time supplies the individual horizon.
A bounded duration supplies the accountability horizon.
One thing standing in for another supplies the substitution explicitly negated by the verse.
The parent-child relation supplies the strongest available bond that still cannot transfer the burden.
A promise fixed by time or place makes the horizon assured.
Deception by what shines but does not endure supplies the force that obscures the horizon.
Life as benefit supplies what can be misread as self-sufficient permanence.

structural_cues: 31:33 uses paired negations across parent and child, then contrasts a true promise with repeated deception immediately after 31:29's كُلٌّ and appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-substitution at a promised day and the focus supplies a distributed course for each luminary; I infer an analogy to individual human accountability. A live alternative confines كُلٌّ grammatically to the sun and moon without extending its distributive force to persons.

changed_reading.before: Each celestial body has its own physical schedule.
changed_reading.after: Each separate schedule rehearses a moral fact: every self approaches a promised horizon that even the nearest relation cannot traverse in its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final context contrasts divine knowledge with the self's ignorance of tomorrow's earning and its land of death, then repeats خَبِير. The observable daily cycle therefore becomes evidence for a designated personal horizon whose existence is visible by analogy but whose coordinates remain concealed.

activation_trace.role: Visible perception anchors the known recurring cycle.
A prescribed term anchors the concealed personal endpoint in the focus.
Expert knowledge of inward affairs supplies the knowing side of the asymmetry.
Human knowing, twice negated in the construction, supplies the limited side of the asymmetry.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies tomorrow's unknown human activity.
The following day supplies the nearest future that still escapes self-knowledge.
Loss of life supplies the personal terminus whose location is unknown.
The repeated expert predicate seals the contrast between designated reality and undisclosed coordinates.

structural_cues: 31:34 heads its list with the Hour, but the supplied س و ع inventory lacks a matching Hour branch, so that lexeme is used only as a structural heading; the verse then repeats وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ and ends خَبِيرٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an observable cycle, an appointed term, explicit human ignorance of tomorrow and death-place, and repeated expertise; I infer that cosmic visibility teaches certainty without disclosure of personal coordinates. A live alternative keeps the term solely astronomical and lets 31:34 introduce personal uncertainty independently.

changed_reading.before: The visible cycle proves that celestial bodies have known endpoints.
changed_reading.after: The visible cycle trains recognition of a personal endpoint that is designated and fully known, even while tomorrow's deed and the place of death remain hidden from the traveler.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س م م target behind مُسَمًّى and spatializes a temporal phrase. It remains anchored in word 20, the repeated ingress construction, and the running-to syntax. Downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant passage image, never as the lexical translation of أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The course runs toward مُسَمًّى after two acts of entry into interiors.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies the constricted-passage image latent in the split root mapping.
An entry place, gorge, or sheltering recess supplies the approach to that passage.
Continuous running supplies motion through rather than mere arrival at the constriction.
The temporal limit keeps the spatial image attached to an endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term is only a date at which motion ends.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can appear as a designated narrow passage through which every running course must finally move.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates the coerced-labor branch of سخر and the hand-worker branch of عمل. Both are directly focus-anchored, and 31:20 repeats subjection as beneficent service. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social-economic analogy and must not imply divine exploitation or replace the primary purposeful-subjection sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَسَخَّرَ the sun and moon is followed in the same sentence by what humans تَعْمَلُونَ.

activation_trace.role: A worker compelled without wage supplies the provocative labor relation.
People working with their hands supply the human labor counterpart.
Knowledge of work's interior supplies audit of the human side of the relation.
Purposeful subjection repeated for human benefit contains the harsher labor image within service and provision.
Blessed good condition identifies the cosmic service's beneficiary frame.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon are neutral instruments while human deeds are a separate topic.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cosmos appears as a tireless service workforce, making the expert audit of beneficiary human labor ethically pointed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves from temporal ingress to social interiority through the وليجة branch. It remains anchored in the doubled يُولِجُ and gains context support from inward associates, followed loyalties, and betrayal. Downstream prose should call it an analogy of adoption and loyalty, not substitute social actors for night and day.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same root that performs reciprocal insertion also carries an image of an outsider admitted as an intimate reliance.

activation_trace.role: An outsider admitted into a group's inner circle supplies the social-entry mechanism.
Knowledge of inward reality anchors the question of what has entered and become operative.
A person's intimate inner associates supply the social interior into which influence enters.
Loyal succession supplies the mechanism by which an admitted pattern persists.
Betrayal and failure of fidelity supply the reversal that reveals unstable inward loyalty.

changed_reading.before: Mutual ingress describes only changing quantities of darkness and light.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social analogy, ingress can also model how an external pattern becomes an inner allegiance whose later work reveals fidelity or betrayal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it preserves the non-dominant و س م target behind مُسَمًّى rather than collapsing the split mapping to naming. It is anchored in word 20, the term at word 19, and the command to see. Downstream prose may say the limit is activated as marked or legible, but should retain 'named' as the primary grammatical reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The named term stands inside a verse framed by seeing and visible celestial courses.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies legibility to the designated endpoint.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the observer capable of reading the mark.
The prescribed duration supplies what the mark identifies.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is verbally specified but otherwise opaque.
changed_reading.after: Alongside being named, the endpoint can be carried as a marked boundary whose signs are already legible in the governed course.

strongest_changes: The visible cycle became a surface-to-interior epistemic arc once 31:20's outward/inward pair and 31:16's nested mustard seed activated خَبِير.
Repeated return-report-work sequences changed the closing knowledge clause into a process of carried work reaching disclosure.
The ship-wave-shore sequence changed abstract celestial running into a contained navigational model of passage through alternating media.
31:34 changed the appointed cosmic term into evidence for a personal horizon that is certain yet undisclosed to the self.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah supports several mechanisms at once: reciprocal temporal ingress, governed finite courses, hydraulic circulation, visibility opening onto interior knowledge, and form-distant social or spatial images. Context did not collapse them; it separately activated ecological, gestational, accountability, scale, navigation, and epistemic readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic and navigational models are coherent across several branches but remain material analogies rather than replacements for the ordinary temporal syntax.
The gestational transition depends on a reader-supplied process analogy between 31:14 and reciprocal day/night ingress.
The س م م and و س م activations behind مُسَمًّى are deliberately preserved split-root outliers and should not be lexicalized without qualification.
The personal extension of كُلٌّ from luminaries to selves is contextually strong but not the immediate grammatical referent in 31:29.
